_about: Public-domain Samuel Reynolds Hole (1819-1904), Dean of Rochester, for the Word Hoard: Addresses spoken to Workingmen from Pulpit and Platform, Our Duty in Danger, The Memories of Dean Hole, More Memories, Then and Now, and A Little Tour in America. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 109 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
